title: A9 motorway: car strikes stopped van
location_guess: A9 motorway near Munich, Germany (TUM Traffic gantry cameras)
summary: Measured frame by frame (12.5 fps) from the bottom-right gantry camera, first 32 s. A white panel van stands stopped in lane 1 (next to the median) of the carriageway toward the camera while traffic steers around it. At 22.32 s a yellow car swerving out of lane 2 strikes the van's rear median-side corner and both come to rest by 23.60 s. 130 other vehicles are reconstructed from their measured tracks.

crash.description: The yellow car leaves lane 2 and its front strikes the rear median-side corner of the white van stopped in lane 1 at 22.32 s (frame 279); measured impulse 9.0 kN·s, peak force 120 kN over 0.12 s. Both vehicles are at rest by 23.60 s.

caveats: Positions, headings and speeds are measured per video frame (12.5 fps) from the bottom-right camera, calibrated on the lane dashes (3.75 m lanes assumed); vehicles are shown only while that camera sees them.
The road is drawn from the measured painted lines: 6 lanes toward the camera (3.64, 3.47, 3.64, 3.78, 3.28, 3.02 m wide) and 3 away (3.79, 3.67, 3.97 m); lateral positions are not shifted.
Forces on the crash pair are derived from the measured motion (m·a) and the momentum exchange at contact, not from instruments.
Vehicle sizes are clamped to the viewer's class ranges (long trucks are drawn shorter).
Pedestrians (the van's driver) and debris are not reconstructed.
